name: issybi-portfolio-builder
description: Plan evidence-based data portfolio projects, review analytical work, and create polished dashboard mockups and interactive prototypes.

interface.longDescription: Plan focused data portfolio projects with evidence scoped to the task, traceable analytical questions and learner judgement. Review existing work or create polished dashboard mockups and interactive prototypes with clearly labelled demonstration data. Production BI integration requires separate implementation and validation. Dashboard design uses inspected Tableau, Dribbble and Figma references where accessible, with explicit style decisions and access limitations.
defaultPrompt: Turn my dataset into a focused portfolio project.
Strengthen the analytical story in my existing project.
